t: Fortress Trade short Pile Roller Sleeves provide a smooth, even finish for professional painting tasks. These 4" microfibre roller sleeves are ideal for applying gloss paint to plastered walls and for final top coats in domestic and commercial environments. The microfibre mix ensures excellent paint load and efficient release, significantly reducing splatter during application. With closed fibres, a consistently smooth texture is achieved, and the thermobonded fabric guarantees minimal lint loss, providing a clean and high-quality result on every job.
b: Closed Fibres for Smooth Even Texture
Thermobonded Fabric Delivers Minimal Lint Loss
